server.restoreConfirm:
Restore the backup from {date} (version {version})?

Everything on this server (all companies, users, work orders and files) is replaced with the backup's contents. A safety backup of the current state is made first.

Type RESTORE to continue.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.body: {company} is the controller of the personal data processed in this maintenance system. For any question about your data, contact us: {contact}.

data.title: What we collect
data.body: Contact details (name, e-mail, phone) of clients, villa contacts, staff and people who report a fault; addresses and access notes of the properties we maintain; maintenance requests, work orders, photos, client signatures and messages; for staff, time logged on jobs; and technical records such as sign-in and security logs.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body: To provide the maintenance services agreed with our clients (performance of a contract), to answer requests and faults reported to us, to plan and document our work, to meet legal obligations such as invoicing and record keeping, and to keep the system secure (legitimate interest).

recipients.title: Who receives it
recipients.body: Only our staff who need it for their work, and service providers that host the system or deliver e-mails on our behalf under a data processing agreement. We do not sell your data or use it for advertising.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: For as long as we provide services to you and afterwards for the periods required by law (for example, accounting records). Data no longer needed is deleted or anonymised.

security.title: How we protect it
security.body: Access is restricted by role, passwords are stored hashed, access codes and device credentials are encrypted and every view of them is logged, and connections are encrypted.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may ask to access, correct or erase your data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to receive it in a portable format. Users can download their data from their profile. You may also complain to your data protection authority (in Portugal, the CNPD).

retention.title: Data retention
retention.hint: Older records are deleted (or, for request forms, the contact details removed) once a day. 0 keeps them forever.
retention.requestersMonths: QR requester contact details (months after the decision)

erasure.eraseHint: Remove this person's name, e-mail, phone and sign-in; their work history stays, without their name.
erasure.eraseConfirm: Erase this person's personal data? Their name, e-mail, phone, password and notifications are removed for good, and they can no longer sign in. Jobs and time they logged stay, under "Former user". This can't be undone.
erasure.anonymizeHint: Remove this client's name, contact details, tax number, notes and contacts; villas and jobs stay.
erasure.anonymizeConfirm: Erase this client's personal data? The name, e-mail, phone, tax number, billing address, notes and all contacts are removed for good. Villas, jobs and contracts stay, under "Former client". This can't be undone.
erasure.otherCompanies: This person also belongs to another company, so the account can't be erased from here. Deactivating them removes their access to this company.
erasure.portalUsers: This client still has active portal users. Deactivate and erase them first.

businessHours.title: Business hours
businessHours.hint: Used by service contracts that count response and resolution times in business hours only. Times are in the company's time zone.
businessHours.holidaysHint: Days the SLA clock doesn't run, one per line (YYYY-MM-DD).

categories.uses: {n, plural, =0 {Not used} one {# work order} other {# work orders}}
categories.deleteConfirm: Delete this category? It is removed from its work orders; the work orders stay.

dateInput.badDate: Enter a valid date as DD/MM/YYYY.

perms.title: Permissions
perms.hint: What each role may do. Roles start with the defaults; tick or untick to change them. A custom role follows its access level until you change it here. Changes apply straight away to everyone in the role.
perms.ownerOnly: Only the Super Admin can change permissions.
perms.resetConfirm: Put every role back to the default permissions?
perms.staffAppHint: Always on for staff roles; client accounts only see the client portal.

reportEmail.title: E-mail the service report
reportEmail.hint: Sends the PDF service report (no costs) to each address separately.
reportEmail.noDefaults: No default recipients: add the client's e-mail, report contacts or company copies, or type addresses below.
reportEmail.lastSent: Last sent {at} to {count, plural, one {# address} other {# addresses}}.
reportEmail.notConfigured: E-mail isn't set up on this server (Settings → Server → E-mail), so the report can't be sent.
reportEmail.noRecipients: Choose or type at least one address.
reportEmail.clientEmailsHint: Extra addresses offered when e-mailing this client's service reports (e.g. a family office), one per line.
reportEmail.contactToggleHint: Whether this contact is offered when e-mailing service reports
reportEmail.companyHint: Offered as recipients whenever a service report is e-mailed, besides the client. The sender can untick them.
reportEmail.subject: Service report #{number}: {title}
reportEmail.body: Please find attached the service report for work order #{number}, "{title}".
reportEmail.bodyVilla: Please find attached the service report for work order #{number}, "{title}", at {villa}.

backupCopies.title: Backup copies
backupCopies.hint: Keep copies of backups off this server: e-mail them, and/or copy them to a cloud folder, as each backup is made.
backupCopies.emailToHint: Up to 5 addresses, one per line. Each gets the backup file attached.
backupCopies.encryptedOnlyHint: A backup holds all data and the encryption keys. Unencrypted, it can be read by anyone who gets the e-mail.
backupCopies.notEncryptedWillSkip: Backups on this server aren't encrypted (BACKUP_PASSWORD isn't set), so with this option only a notice is e-mailed, without the file.
backupCopies.notEncryptedWarning: Backups on this server aren't encrypted: e-mailed copies can be read by anyone who gets them. Set BACKUP_PASSWORD to encrypt them.
backupCopies.maxMbHint: Bigger backups are not attached: a notice is sent instead. Most mail servers accept 20–35 MB.
backupCopies.folderHint: Path inside the drive, e.g. Backups/Maintenance. Created if it doesn't exist.
backupCopies.folderHintGdrive: Created by the app in My Drive (with the drive.file permission, the app only sees folders it created).
backupCopies.mirrorDeletes: Remove from the cloud the backups removed here
backupCopies.mirrorDeletesHint: Old backups deleted by the schedule (or by hand) are deleted from the folder too, so it doesn't fill up.
backupCopies.onedriveSetup: Once: in Microsoft Entra ID (portal.azure.com) → App registrations → New registration (accounts: any organisational directory and personal Microsoft accounts, or only yours), add this redirect URI (Web), then create a client secret under Certificates & secrets. Paste the Application (client) ID and the secret below, save, then Connect.
backupCopies.gdriveSetup: Once: in Google Cloud Console create a project, enable the Google Drive API, configure the OAuth consent screen and publish it (in "Testing" the sign-in expires after 7 days), then create an OAuth client (Web application) with this redirect URI. Paste the client ID and secret below, save, then Connect.
backupCopies.tenantHint: "consumers" for a personal Microsoft account (outlook.com, hotmail…), "common" for any account, or your directory ID / domain if the app is for your organisation only.
backupCopies.siteUrlHint: Leave empty to use the signed-in account's OneDrive; or a site URL to use its document library (work accounts only). After switching between OneDrive and a site, connect again.
backupCopies.saveFirst: Fill in the client ID and secret and save, then connect.
backupCopies.testCloudOk: Test file uploaded to "{folder}", listed and removed.
backupCopies.cloudNotReady: Choose a destination and fill it in (and connect, for OneDrive or Google Drive) first.

oauth.connected: Connected. Backups will be copied to the cloud folder.
oauth.denied: The sign-in was cancelled or refused.
oauth.badState: The sign-in link expired. Unlock Settings → Server and connect again.
oauth.locked: Sign in to the app and connect again.
oauth.noRefresh: The account didn't grant offline access. Connect again and accept all permissions.
oauth.missingApp: Save the client ID and secret first.

mail.subject: {app} backup: {name}
mail.attachedEncrypted: A backup was made: {name} ({size}). It is attached, encrypted: restoring it needs this server's BACKUP_PASSWORD.
mail.attachedPlain: A backup was made: {name} ({size}). It is attached. It is not encrypted: keep it somewhere safe.
mail.tooBig: A backup was made: {name} ({size}), but it is larger than the {max} limit for e-mail, so it isn't attached. Download it from Settings → Server.
mail.notEncrypted: A backup was made: {name} ({size}). It isn't attached because only encrypted backups are e-mailed and this one isn't encrypted.
mail.testBody: This is a test. Backups will be e-mailed to this address.
